content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Delhi Administrative Assistant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 20-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Administrative Assistant post at AIIMS Delhi is 20th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Administrative Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in a Scientific discipline from a recognized university. Desirable qualifications include experience in specific lab techniques and computer skills.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Administrative Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Administrative Assistant post is 45 years. There is no minimum age specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications, followed by an interview. A virtual interview may also be conducted as part of the selection procedure.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Administrative Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 35,400/- per month for the Administrative Assistant role.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the AIIMS Delhi Administrative Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. How should I apply for the Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary details and documents and send it to the official email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of all required documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Administrative Assistant position at AIIMS Delhi is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.
